1.1.0: Compares two real options for a code change on interface size, callers touched, migration cost and reversibility, and says what would change the choice.
Writes one-page decision records in your project's own format, naming who decided, what gets worse and the check that keeps the code to it.
Plans module moves as small steps that each keep behaviour unchanged, each with its own build, test and structure check.
Answers developers before risky structural changes, and gives OK or no on hard size limits with a written reason.
Keeps code structure in check with code-structure: a size scan before and after every planned move.
